description: Shell script for testing various scenarios of git merge involving submodules, including conflict detection, merge abort, and special cases such as directory/submodule conflicts and no-merge-base situations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test scenario expected to succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after test.

methods.name: test_path_is_dir
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a directory.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a given path does not exist.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks number of lines in output.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Performs a grep search in files.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified message.
